assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Triangle ABC with the line YX through C parallel to AB; the bisector from A (blue) meets BC at D and the line at X, the bisector from B (red) meets AC at E and the line at Y, and the segments XD and YE are drawn thick.

difficulty_rationale: Needs the isosceles triangles created by the parallel line, a similarity to express XD and YE, and a monotonicity argument to compare them.
